WITH required_skus AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE pv.brand = 'Sika'
    AND pv.product_name LIKE '%Sika 28T-UV8 Sealant%'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'sealant type' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'hybrid sealant')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'color family' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'Gray')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pvp WHERE pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pvp.property_key = 'volume' AND pvp.property_value_text = '300 ml')
)
SELECT r.product_sku, r.record_path,
       CASE WHEN extra.product_sku IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_extra_volume
FROM required_skus r
LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties extra ON extra.product_sku = r.product_sku AND extra.property_key = 'volume' AND extra.property_value_text = '310 ml';
